effect_description_eng:
While you have a Tamer, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP. Then, add this card to the hand.
[Main] You may link this card to 1 of your Digimon without paying the cost. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as 1 of your Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng:
Link Requirements [Link] Lv.3 or higher: Cost 2 
(Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)
